notes.title: Chasing Tail 4.0 Update!
notes.content: New changes to Chasing Tail are live! The biggest change is the reworked backgrounds that have given the game some new life and improved the style. There are also many minor bug fixes and spelling corrections through the game. Most notable is an error in Kase's date that would not allow certain text to play out. The way the game calculates the love interest has also gotten a bit of a tweak and now places a much bigger emphasis on the dates seen.

notes.title: Chasing Tail 3.1 Update!
notes.content:
Time for a new update with new features! 

One of the biggest changes with this version is the 3D section of the game has gotten some brand new models! These models were custom created and designed to fit a little better into a scifi-ish setting and have replaced the current minecraft style buildings within the game. I'm very happy with this change and only wish it got done sooner.

Along with the new buildings in the 3D world is the addition of Mini Scenes. 4 mini scenes have been added and can be found from the 3D section. These mini scenes aim to ad a bit more world building or minor story events. A new bonus scene with another erotic ending is also planned to be added next.

The last major update is sprites have been optimized. Before a character could have 3 body variations and 3 expression variations and 9 total complete sprites, but now the sprites have been split into bodies and expressions. This allows the previous 9 to be shrunk to 6 and the total size to be reduced by 66% for sprites. This means the PC version of the game takes much less storage space, and the web and mobile versions of the game can use the same storage space but with higher fidelity sprites! This last update though has caused some issues with sprites that sometimes appear with a seem that I'll have to fix in future updates.

All in all I'm very happy with this update and look forward to future improvements!

-Scylez <3
